title: Records ordered by the work queue
goal: The generated ledger lists records inside each group in work-queue order by default (ready first, then blocked, then waiting on a human), with the ID order available as a setting
acceptance: `workItems.order`: `queue` (default for new adoptions) or `id`; existing projects keep `id` until they opt in at reconcile
The order comes from tools/backlog-queue.mjs, so the ledger and the queue page never disagree
A merge of two branches regenerates the same order (deterministic tie-break by ID)
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: Fixtures: queue order, id order, ties, a record with no queue entry placed last

effort.basis: backlog-queue already computes the ranking; renderLedger takes an order. Implemented 2026-11-11 in one branch with F-053–F-055; review and release remain. Estimate, not a measurement.

escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner (BACKLOG-RULES, "Optional upfront feature plans")
